summary: Completed the isolated exploration acceptance checkpoint across real terminal grids. The combined Files A/B -> open -> return -> folder Search -> preview -> open -> return -> resume journey passed, as did rapid-query stale-result rejection, tab isolation, tab-close cancellation, missing-rg behavior and resource teardown. The host-facing feature launcher/autoconf adapter and Nix defaults remain WB-25 scope; WB-11 made no runtime startup, theme or Nix changes.

gates.command: make check-ownership; git diff --check; inspect docs/tasks.json#WB-11 allowed paths, package facade and controller/provider ownership
gates.result: WB-11-owned implementation paths are tests/, bench/ and Makefile, with task/evidence documentation under the implicit docs paths. The only new acceptance behavior is test/harness code; no production Lua or host configuration changed. Files and Search controllers own per-tab session/view state; filesystem and rg providers own their asynchronous requests, and layout owns workbench windows/buffers. The combined teardown confirms zero views, sessions and provider requests. Ownership validation passed for 22 Lua modules. Public API review confirmed lazy require('workbench') boundaries and a status-only :Workbench command; default host feature launch remains WB-25.

gates.command: make test; make test-integration; make test-e2e
gates.result: All 70 mini.test cases passed on Neovim 0.11.7 and 0.12.4; all 21 Python integration/plan tests passed and the planning checker reported valid structure. Behavior includes a real-rg A-folder query while cwd is B, 110 real matches, modified-buffer preview, return/resume, deterministic latest-generation selection, explicit missing-rg reason, and a three-cycle capability toggle test that owns and releases exactly one autocmd while preserving a sibling capability.

gates.command: make test; make test-ui; make test-e2e
gates.result: Three actual capability disable/re-enable cycles left one hook while active, zero while disabled, and preserved the sibling action/hook. Existing Search tests completed 100 repeated missing-rg view open/close cycles with zero views or requests. In the combined UI path, first/second rapid searches were cancelled, a delayed first-generation batch was ignored, closing a tab cancelled its pending request and rejected a deliberately delivered late batch, and final teardown returned Search/Files/layout/rg/filesystem inventories to zero on both Neovim versions.

The complete make test-e2e target exited 0. A fresh real RPC-grid walkthrough passed on 160x50, 120x35, 80x24 and 60x20 for both Neovim 0.11.7 and 0.12.4. UX-01/02/03/04, the Search→preview→open→return→resume portion of UX-05, UX-06, UX-09 and UX-11 are covered by real filesystem/rg fixtures and actual key/mouse input. The controlled race proves stale batches do not enter the latest result set; result-set IDs are captured independently from provider request session IDs. UX-07 is covered by the three-cycle lifecycle test; UX-08 by unavailable-rg action/palette tests and rendered state. Teardown ends with zero Search/Files/layout/rg/filesystem resources.

gates.command: make test-e2e; review .bench-output/startup/20260912T200922Z-baseline-d96b84/baseline.json and WB-10 provider evidence
gates.result: Across the eight fresh WB-11 Neovim/grid runs, Files root-to-first-page measured 19.377–24.836 ms, Search shell invocation 3.117–10.586 ms, and folder-search input-to-completion for 110 real results 92.667–102.131 ms. The controlled 20-pair host startup marker profile from WB-10 was p50/p95 44.120/51.356 ms versus WB-09 43.745/44.236 ms, delta +0.375/+7.120 ms; WB-11 changed only tests, test-target wiring and documentation, so no production startup path was added. Search-provider normal-fixture and memory/cancellation budgets are recorded in WB-10 evidence.

gates.command: make test; make test-integration; make test-e2e; inspect lazy package facade and host command boundaries
gates.result: Minimum/current Neovim 0.11.7 and 0.12.4 tests passed in isolated --clean runtimes, including simulated missing ripgrep (unavailable capability, no empty-query process spawn, typed missing_dependency and precise palette reason). Standalone controller composition and real-grid behavior passed. Autoconf launch/default wiring, theme, and Nix installation are intentionally not part of this isolated checkpoint; WB-25 owns host integration and no related paths changed. Linux was not available locally and remains an outstanding broader release platform check; all locally runnable WB-11 compatibility gates passed on macOS.
